findings.title: The chase cell completes least often of the three
findings.detail: 82% against 98% and 99%. It is the only one that waits on someone outside operations.
findings.action: Look at what it is waiting for before treating the number as a fault.

findings.title: Readiness and handover are the most tightly coupled pair here
findings.detail: They share every declared path and run within the same hour on 92% of days.

limits: Weekend shifts are in the window but are a fifth of the runs, so weekend-only patterns are weak.
